notes: Fixed the focal query to traverse the full assigned route (teams -> channels -> channel_members, three nodes) rather than stopping at channels; the channel_name filter is applied at the channels node while the route itself continues through conversation_membership as required. The two auxiliary queries extend that same full route one additional join to users purely to apply the user-facing real_name identifying predicate for Kenji Sato and Priya Sharma, respectively (users is not part of the assigned route but is a documented join used only to evaluate the named-person condition, not to restrict the candidate scope). The sole workspace T01WORKSPACE is excluded because the channel named 'circuit-tracer-gpu' (C09PLMK71) does not contain both named users as members, while the channel that does contain both (core-infra, C_INFRA) has a different name — so both auxiliary constraints return zero tuples for the only team in the corpus, correctly yielding an absent result. No new users were needed; Sophie Dubois, Olena Petrenko, and Robert Chen were reused from the base seed as the wrong-membership set. Actor access: conversations.list and conversations.members work on public channels without requiring actor membership per the documented API, so no additional channel memberships were granted to the actor; workspace name lookup is otherwise unsupported and not relied upon.
